## StreamDek Mobile v0.0.12

This release focuses on making StreamDek easier to configure, easier to personalize, and more powerful when it comes to playback and stream selection.

### What's New

- Redesigned Settings experience with clearer sections for General, Playback, Subtitles, Home & Appearance, Streams, Account & Services, and App Updates.
- Localization support across the app, including translated interface and settings text.
- A dedicated Streams preferences section for stream-specific controls.
- Stream controls now include Show Streams List, Preferred Stream Quality, Max File Size, and Fusion badge options.
- Fusion badge support for stream results, with customizable badge sources, badge position, and optional size badges.
- Expanded playback controls including decoder mode, render surface selection, Picture-in-Picture, and local server / streaming mode options.
- Improved subtitle preferences, including auto-load, Hearing Impaired subtitle preference, and forced subtitle preference.
- More home screen customization with page style selection, continue watching styles, ambient background control, hero synopsis toggles, and editable home layout sections.
- TMDB customization options, including metadata provider selection and support for a custom TMDB API key.
- Better account and service management for sync, addons, debrid services, Trakt, and TV linking.
- App update management is now built into Settings, including current version info, automatic update checks, and manual update checks.

### Highlights

This update is a major settings and customization release. StreamDek now gives you more control over how streams are displayed, how playback behaves, how subtitles are handled, and how the app looks and feels overall.

It also lays the groundwork for a more global experience with localization support and continues improving stream selection with new badge and filtering tools.

### Notes

- Existing users should review the updated Settings layout, as some stream-related options now live under the `Streams` section.
- This release continues to build on recent playback, subtitle, and update-management improvements introduced in prior versions.
